controls.title: Unique User Identification
controls.description: Assign a unique name/number for identifying and tracking user identity.

controls.title: Emergency Access Procedure
controls.description: Establish procedures for obtaining necessary ePHI during an emergency.

controls.title: Automatic Logoff
controls.description: Terminate electronic sessions after a predetermined time of inactivity.

controls.title: Audit Controls
controls.description: Implement hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms to record and examine activity.

controls.title: Integrity Controls
controls.description: Implement policies/procedures to protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction.

controls.title: Notice of Privacy Practices
controls.description: Provide notice of privacy practices and obtain acknowledgment where applicable.
